newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria industry output rises three percent in H1.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria industry output rises three percent in H1.

text.p: Nigeria's industrial sector recorded three percent growth in the first half of 1996, the Central Bank said.
"Performance in the industrial sector improved modestly in the first half of 1996," the bank's half-year economic report released on Wednesday said.
It said the overall rate of capacity utilisation by industries rose to 32.5 percent from 29.4 percent in the same 1995 period.
The improvement was attributed partly to the stock of raw materials carried over from 1995 and enhanced access to foreign exchange by manufacturers, it said.
The introduction of concessions for imports clearing at the ports also played a positive role, the report added.
Finance Minister Anthony Ani in February announced sweeping reforms aimed at facilitating clearing of imports and cutting the logjam at the country's ports.
